2608.30975.title: MR-JEPA: A General Purpose Video Foundation Model for Cardiac MRI
2608.30975.paper_summary: Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) produces rich sequential data such as temporal cine videos and spatial LGE/mapping stacks, yet most deep learning approaches process individual 2D slices, discarding this context. We present MR-JEPA, a self-supervised video foundation model for CMR that extends LeJEPA to 3D spatiotemporal inputs through tubelet tokenization, spatiotemporal masking augmentation, and initialization from a 2D CMR foundation model. Unlike prior CMR video models limited to cine data, MR-JEPA is pretrained on multi-sequence data (cine, LGE, mapping) from 10,505 patients across two centers without annotations. We evaluate the frozen encoder on six downstream tasks using a unified multi-view gated attention architecture: LV ejection fraction, RV ejection fraction, three myocardial strains (GLS, GCS, GRS), and four-class disease detection. MR-JEPA outperforms other compared methods on all five regression tasks, including both a domain-specific CMR model pretrained on more data with text supervision and a natural-video foundation model, achieving an LV EF MAE of 4.79% (r =0.764) and a GLS MAE of 1.87 (r=0.805), with 21-27% MAE reductions over baselines on strain tasks. For disease detection, MR-JEPA achieved a macro AUG of 0.868, remaining competitive with the domain-specific baseline despite using a fully self-supervised pretraining objective. These results demonstrate the potential of a unified video encoder for robust, multi-view utilization of diverse CMR sequences in clinical cardiac quantification and diagnosis.
2608.30975.paper_summary_zh: 心臟磁共振成像（CMR）產生豐富的序列數據，例如時間序列影像和空間 LGE/映射堆疊，然而大多數深度學習方法處理單獨的 2D 切片，忽略了這些上下文。我們提出了 MR-JEPA，一個自我監督的 CMR 影像基礎模型，通過管狀標記化、時空遮罩增強和從 2D CMR 基礎模型初始化，將 LeJEPA 擴展到 3D 時空輸入。與以往僅限於電影數據的 CMR 影像模型不同，MR-JEPA 在來自兩個中心的 10,505 名患者的多序列數據（電影、LGE、映射）上進行了無標註的預訓練。我們使用統一的多視圖門控注意力架構對六個下游任務評估凍結的編碼器：左心室射血分數、右心室射血分數、三種心肌應變（GLS、GCS、GRS）和四類疾病檢測。在所有五個回歸任務中，MR-JEPA 的表現超過了其他比較方法，包括一個在更多數據上進行文本監督預訓練的領域特定 CMR 模型和一個自然影像基礎模型，達到左心室 EF MAE 為 4.79%（r =0.764）和 GLS MAE 為 1.87（r=0.805），在應變任務上相較基準減少 21-27% 的 MAE。對於疾病檢測，MR-JEPA 的宏觀 AUG 為 0.868，儘管使用了完全自我監督的預訓練目標，仍與領域特定基準保持競爭力。這些結果展示了統一影像編碼器在臨床心臟量化和診斷中對多樣 CMR 序列進行穩健多視圖利用的潛力。
